what.text: This page follows refugees from Ukraine living in Poland.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 972287 Ukrainian refugees in Poland, 18.6% of all Ukrainian refugees.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine from 2022 to 2025, at war level in every one of those years.
Before that it records armed conflict over Novorossiya territory, with the DPR and LPR, from 2014 to 2022.

when.text: The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025, after a big change between 2021 and 2022.
UNHCR's figure for Poland peaked at 991223 in 2024 and was 972287 at the end of 2025.
Returns from Poland to Ukraine were highest in 2022 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees in Poland only, and UNHCR adds notes to some of them.
People displaced inside Ukraine are counted separately by UNHCR and by IDMC, and their figures are never added.
The sources don't say which routes people took.
